comment: Candidate sources for the Scout to qualify. These are leads, not trusted capabilities — each must pass a live probe, get a drafted manifest, and survive quarantine before promotion into manifests/.

candidates.name: Census Geocoder one-line address
candidates.notes: US Census geocoder: free, keyless address-to-coordinates with FIPS-bearing match data

candidates.name: NWS active weather alerts
candidates.notes: Official NWS active watches/warnings feed, GeoJSON, keyless

candidates.name: USGS EPQS point elevation
candidates.notes: US elevation for a coordinate from the USGS 3DEP elevation service, keyless

candidates.name: Frankfurter ECB exchange rates
candidates.notes: European Central Bank reference FX rates, keyless, good fallback for source.erapi.exchange_rates

candidates.name: Open Library book search
candidates.notes: Internet Archive's Open Library search: bibliographic records, keyless

candidates.name: REST Countries reference data
candidates.notes: Country reference data (names, codes, capitals, population), keyless

candidates.name: Open-Meteo air quality
candidates.notes: Hourly air-quality forecast (PM2.5 etc.) for any coordinate, keyless

candidates.name: NOAA tides and currents water level
candidates.notes: Near-real-time water level at NOAA station 8594900 (Washington DC), keyless

candidates.name: openFDA drug adverse events
candidates.notes: FDA adverse event reports, keyless up to 240 requests/min per IP

candidates.name: CoinGecko simple price
candidates.notes: Crypto spot prices, keyless with strict rate limits — expect occasional 429s
